```{r}
## summarize_and_plot_combined_results.R
## use the single combined csv file
## no files will be saved; tables are printed and plots are shown on screen

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

INPUT_CSV <-  "beta_div_sparse12_all_results.csv"
ALPHA <- 0.05

if (!file.exists(INPUT_CSV)) {
  stop("Combined csv not found: ", INPUT_CSV)
}

dat <- read.csv(INPUT_CSV, check.names = FALSE)

## remove accidental index columns if present
bad_cols <- c("X", "...1", "row.names")
dat <- dat[, setdiff(names(dat), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]

cat("Loaded file:", INPUT_CSV, "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(dat), "\n\n")

## -------------------------------------------------
## basic checks
## -------------------------------------------------
req_cols <- c("rep_id", "k", "signal_cluster", "cluster_ordered",
              "signal_mode", "beta", "is_null")
miss_req <- setdiff(req_cols, names(dat))
if (length(miss_req) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(miss_req, collapse = ", "))
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns found. Expected columns starting with 'p_'.")
}

cat("Detected p-value methods:\n")
print(p_cols)
cat("\n")

## -------------------------------------------------
## reshape to long format
## -------------------------------------------------
long_list <- lapply(p_cols, function(pc) {
  data.frame(
    rep_id = dat$rep_id,
    k = dat$k,
    signal_cluster = dat$signal_cluster,
    cluster_ordered = dat$cluster_ordered,
    cluster_abund_sum_template = if ("cluster_abund_sum_template" %in% names(dat)) dat$cluster_abund_sum_template else NA_real_,
    cluster_n_otus_template = if ("cluster_n_otus_template" %in% names(dat)) dat$cluster_n_otus_template else NA_real_,
    signal_mode = dat$signal_mode,
    beta = dat$beta,
    is_null = dat$is_null,
    n_samples = if ("n_samples" %in% names(dat)) dat$n_samples else NA_real_,
    y_mean = if ("y_mean" %in% names(dat)) dat$y_mean else NA_real_,
    runtime_sec = if ("runtime_sec" %in% names(dat)) dat$runtime_sec else NA_real_,
    method = sub("^p_", "", pc),
    p_value = dat[[pc]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

long_dat <- do.call(rbind, long_list)
rownames(long_dat) <- NULL

long_dat <- long_dat[is.finite(long_dat$p_value) & !is.na(long_dat$p_value), , drop = FALSE]
long_dat$reject <- as.integer(long_dat$p_value < ALPHA)
long_dat$signal_mode <- factor(long_dat$signal_mode, levels = c("abundance", "prevalence", "both"))
long_dat$is_null <- as.integer(long_dat$is_null)

cat("Non-missing method-specific rows:", nrow(long_dat), "\n\n")

## -------------------------------------------------
## helpers
## -------------------------------------------------
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, trim = TRUE)
}

summarize_rate <- function(d, group_vars) {
  sp <- split(d, interaction(d[, group_vars], drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE))
  out <- lapply(sp, function(z) {
    ans <- z[1, group_vars, drop = FALSE]
    ans$n_test <- nrow(z)
    ans$mean_p <- mean(z$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans$median_p <- median(z$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans$sd_p <- sd(z$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans$reject_rate <- mean(z$reject, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, out)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

## -------------------------------------------------
## printed summary tables
## -------------------------------------------------

## 1) overall run structure
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Overall structure\n")
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Unique rep_id:", length(unique(dat$rep_id)), "\n")
cat("Unique K:", paste(sort(unique(dat$k)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Unique signal modes:", paste(unique(as.character(dat$signal_mode)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Unique beta:", paste(sort(unique(dat$beta)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

cat("Rows by K x signal_mode x beta:\n")
print(ftable(dat$k, dat$signal_mode, dat$beta))
cat("\n")

## 2) overall type I error table
type1_tab <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, is_null == 1 | beta == 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "k")
)
type1_tab <- type1_tab[order(type1_tab$signal_mode, type1_tab$k, type1_tab$method), ]

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Type I error table (beta = 0)\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(type1_tab)
cat("\n")

## 3) overall power table
power_tab <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, beta > 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "k", "beta")
)
power_tab <- power_tab[order(power_tab$signal_mode, power_tab$k, power_tab$beta, power_tab$method), ]

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Power table (beta > 0)\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(power_tab)
cat("\n")

## 4) type I error averaged over K
type1_avg_method <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, is_null == 1 | beta == 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode")
)
type1_avg_method <- type1_avg_method[order(type1_avg_method$signal_mode, type1_avg_method$reject_rate, type1_avg_method$method), ]

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Average type I error by method and signal mode\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(type1_avg_method)
cat("\n")

## 5) power averaged over K and beta
power_avg_method <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, beta > 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode")
)
power_avg_method <- power_avg_method[order(power_avg_method$signal_mode, -power_avg_method$reject_rate, power_avg_method$method), ]

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Average power by method and signal mode\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(power_avg_method)
cat("\n")

## 6) power by beta averaged over K
power_beta_avg <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, beta > 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "beta")
)
power_beta_avg <- power_beta_avg[order(power_beta_avg$signal_mode, power_beta_avg$beta, -power_beta_avg$reject_rate), ]

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Average power by method, signal mode, and beta\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(power_beta_avg)
cat("\n")

## 7) cluster-order effect table
cluster_power_tab <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, beta > 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "k", "cluster_ordered", "beta")
)
cluster_power_tab <- cluster_power_tab[order(cluster_power_tab$signal_mode,
                                             cluster_power_tab$k,
                                             cluster_power_tab$beta,
                                             cluster_power_tab$cluster_ordered,
                                             cluster_power_tab$method), ]

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Power by ordered signal cluster\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(cluster_power_tab)
cat("\n")

## 8) runtime summary
if ("runtime_sec" %in% names(long_dat)) {
  runtime_tab <- aggregate(runtime_sec ~ signal_mode + k, data = unique(dat[c("rep_id","setting_id","signal_mode","k","runtime_sec")]), 
                           FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                               max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  runtime_df <- data.frame(
    signal_mode = runtime_tab$signal_mode,
    k = runtime_tab$k,
    mean_runtime = sapply(runtime_tab$runtime_sec, function(x) x[1]),
    median_runtime = sapply(runtime_tab$runtime_sec, function(x) x[2]),
    sd_runtime = sapply(runtime_tab$runtime_sec, function(x) x[3]),
    min_runtime = sapply(runtime_tab$runtime_sec, function(x) x[4]),
    max_runtime = sapply(runtime_tab$runtime_sec, function(x) x[5])
  )
  runtime_df <- runtime_df[order(runtime_df$signal_mode, runtime_df$k), ]

  cat("========================================\n")
  cat("Runtime summary by signal mode and K\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
  print(runtime_df)
  cat("\n")
}

## -------------------------------------------------
## printed compact ranking tables
## -------------------------------------------------
cat("========================================\n")
cat("Best methods by average power within each signal mode\n")
cat("========================================\n")
split_power <- split(power_avg_method, power_avg_method$signal_mode)
for (nm in names(split_power)) {
  cat("\nSignal mode:", nm, "\n")
  tmp <- split_power[[nm]][order(-split_power[[nm]]$reject_rate, split_power[[nm]]$method), ]
  print(head(tmp, 10))
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Methods closest to nominal type I error 0.05 within each signal mode\n")
cat("========================================\n")
type1_avg_method$abs_dev_from_0.05 <- abs(type1_avg_method$reject_rate - 0.05)
split_type1 <- split(type1_avg_method, type1_avg_method$signal_mode)
for (nm in names(split_type1)) {
  cat("\nSignal mode:", nm, "\n")
  tmp <- split_type1[[nm]][order(split_type1[[nm]]$abs_dev_from_0.05, split_type1[[nm]]$method), ]
  print(head(tmp, 10))
}

## -------------------------------------------------
## visualization
## -------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("\nggplot2 is not installed, so only printed tables were produced.\n")
} else {
  library(ggplot2)

  ## 1) power curve by beta
  p1 <- ggplot(
    subset(power_tab, beta > 0),
    aes(x = beta, y = reject_rate, group = method, color = method)
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    facet_grid(signal_mode ~ k) +
    labs(
      title = "Power by effect size",
      x = "Effect size (beta)",
      y = paste0("Power: P(p < ", ALPHA, ")"),
      color = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  ## 2) type I error by method
  p2 <- ggplot(
    type1_tab,
    aes(x = method, y = reject_rate, color = method)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ALPHA, linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4) +
    facet_grid(signal_mode ~ k) +
    labs(
      title = "Type I error by method",
      x = "Method",
      y = paste0("Type I error: P(p < ", ALPHA, ")")
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  ## 3) cluster-ordered power heatmap
  p3 <- ggplot(
    subset(cluster_power_tab, beta > 0),
    aes(x = factor(cluster_ordered), y = method, fill = reject_rate)
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(signal_mode + beta ~ k) +
    labs(
      title = "Power by ordered signal cluster",
      x = "Signal cluster ordered by template abundance",
      y = "Method",
      fill = "Power"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

  ## 4) p-value distribution under null
  p4 <- ggplot(
    subset(long_dat, beta == 0),
    aes(x = p_value, color = method, fill = method)
  ) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, position = "identity", alpha = 0.20) +
    facet_grid(signal_mode ~ k) +
    labs(
      title = "Null p-value distribution",
      x = "p-value",
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  print(p1)
  print(p2)
  print(p3)
  print(p4)
}
```

```{r}
## save_visualizations_combined_results.R
## read the combined csv, print summary tables, and save clear PNG figures under figs/

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

INPUT_CSV <-"beta_div_sparse12_all_results.csv"
FIG_DIR   <- Sys.getenv("FIG_DIR", "figs")
ALPHA     <- 0.05
DPI       <- 320

if (!file.exists(INPUT_CSV)) {
  stop("Combined csv not found: ", INPUT_CSV)
}

if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'ggplot2' is required.")
}

library(ggplot2)

dir.create(FIG_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dat <- read.csv(INPUT_CSV, check.names = FALSE)

## remove accidental index columns if present
bad_cols <- c("X", "...1", "row.names")
dat <- dat[, setdiff(names(dat), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]

cat("Loaded file:", INPUT_CSV, "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(dat), "\n")
cat("Figure directory:", FIG_DIR, "\n\n")

## -------------------------------------------------
## basic checks
## -------------------------------------------------
req_cols <- c("rep_id", "k", "signal_cluster", "cluster_ordered",
              "signal_mode", "beta", "is_null")
miss_req <- setdiff(req_cols, names(dat))
if (length(miss_req) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(miss_req, collapse = ", "))
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns found. Expected columns starting with 'p_'.")
}

cat("Detected methods:\n")
print(sub("^p_", "", p_cols))
cat("\n")

## -------------------------------------------------
## reshape to long format
## -------------------------------------------------
long_list <- lapply(p_cols, function(pc) {
  data.frame(
    rep_id = dat$rep_id,
    k = dat$k,
    signal_cluster = dat$signal_cluster,
    cluster_ordered = dat$cluster_ordered,
    cluster_abund_sum_template = if ("cluster_abund_sum_template" %in% names(dat)) dat$cluster_abund_sum_template else NA_real_,
    cluster_n_otus_template = if ("cluster_n_otus_template" %in% names(dat)) dat$cluster_n_otus_template else NA_real_,
    signal_mode = dat$signal_mode,
    beta = dat$beta,
    is_null = dat$is_null,
    n_samples = if ("n_samples" %in% names(dat)) dat$n_samples else NA_real_,
    y_mean = if ("y_mean" %in% names(dat)) dat$y_mean else NA_real_,
    runtime_sec = if ("runtime_sec" %in% names(dat)) dat$runtime_sec else NA_real_,
    method = sub("^p_", "", pc),
    p_value = dat[[pc]],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})

long_dat <- do.call(rbind, long_list)
rownames(long_dat) <- NULL
long_dat <- long_dat[is.finite(long_dat$p_value) & !is.na(long_dat$p_value), , drop = FALSE]
long_dat$reject <- as.integer(long_dat$p_value < ALPHA)

## keep consistent order
signal_mode_levels <- c("abundance", "prevalence", "both")
signal_mode_levels <- signal_mode_levels[signal_mode_levels %in% unique(as.character(long_dat$signal_mode))]
long_dat$signal_mode <- factor(as.character(long_dat$signal_mode), levels = signal_mode_levels)

## -------------------------------------------------
## helpers
## -------------------------------------------------
summarize_rate <- function(d, group_vars) {
  sp <- split(d, interaction(d[, group_vars], drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE))
  out <- lapply(sp, function(z) {
    ans <- z[1, group_vars, drop = FALSE]
    ans$n_test <- nrow(z)
    ans$mean_p <- mean(z$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans$median_p <- median(z$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans$sd_p <- sd(z$p_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans$reject_rate <- mean(z$reject, na.rm = TRUE)
    ans
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, out)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

save_png <- function(plot_obj, filename, width, height, dpi = 320) {
  out_path <- file.path(FIG_DIR, filename)
  ggsave(
    filename = out_path,
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    dpi = dpi,
    limitsize = FALSE,
    bg = "white"
  )
  cat("Saved:", out_path, "\n")
}

clean_filename_num <- function(x) {
  gsub("\\.", "p", as.character(x))
}

## -------------------------------------------------
## summary tables
## -------------------------------------------------
type1_tab <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, is_null == 1 | beta == 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "k")
)
type1_tab <- type1_tab[order(type1_tab$signal_mode, type1_tab$k, type1_tab$method), ]

power_tab <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, beta > 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "k", "beta")
)
power_tab <- power_tab[order(power_tab$signal_mode, power_tab$k, power_tab$beta, power_tab$method), ]

power_avg_tab <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, beta > 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "beta")
)
power_avg_tab <- power_avg_tab[order(power_avg_tab$signal_mode, power_avg_tab$beta, -power_avg_tab$reject_rate), ]

cluster_power_tab <- summarize_rate(
  subset(long_dat, beta > 0),
  c("method", "signal_mode", "k", "cluster_ordered", "beta")
)
cluster_power_tab <- cluster_power_tab[order(cluster_power_tab$signal_mode,
                                             cluster_power_tab$beta,
                                             cluster_power_tab$k,
                                             cluster_power_tab$cluster_ordered,
                                             cluster_power_tab$method), ]

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Type I error table (beta = 0)\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(type1_tab)
cat("\n")

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Power table (beta > 0)\n")
cat("========================================\n")
print(power_tab)
cat("\n")

## -------------------------------------------------
## make plots, one signal_mode per file
## -------------------------------------------------
for (mode_i in signal_mode_levels) {

  ## ---------------- power curves ----------------
  power_i <- subset(power_tab, signal_mode == mode_i)
  if (nrow(power_i) > 0) {
    ord_methods <- aggregate(reject_rate ~ method, data = power_i, FUN = mean)
    ord_methods <- ord_methods[order(-ord_methods$reject_rate, ord_methods$method), "method"]
    power_i$method <- factor(power_i$method, levels = ord_methods)

    p_power <- ggplot(
      power_i,
      aes(x = beta, y = reject_rate, group = method, color = method)
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
      geom_point(size = 2.2) +
      facet_wrap(~ k, ncol = 3) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Power curves -", mode_i, "signal"),
        subtitle = "One panel per K; larger values indicate better detection",
        x = "Effect size (beta)",
        y = paste0("Power = P(p < ", ALPHA, ")"),
        color = "Method"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11)
      )

    save_png(
      p_power,
      paste0("power_curve_", mode_i, ".png"),
      width = 16,
      height = 11,
      dpi = DPI
    )
  }

  ## ---------------- type I error ----------------
  type1_i <- subset(type1_tab, signal_mode == mode_i)
  if (nrow(type1_i) > 0) {
    ord_methods <- aggregate(reject_rate ~ method, data = type1_i, FUN = mean)
    ord_methods <- ord_methods[order(ord_methods$reject_rate, ord_methods$method), "method"]
    type1_i$method <- factor(type1_i$method, levels = ord_methods)

    p_type1 <- ggplot(
      type1_i,
      aes(x = method, y = reject_rate)
    ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = ALPHA, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      facet_wrap(~ k, ncol = 3) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Type I error -", mode_i, "signal"),
        subtitle = "Dashed line marks nominal 0.05 level",
        x = "Method",
        y = paste0("Type I error = P(p < ", ALPHA, ")")
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
      )

    save_png(
      p_type1,
      paste0("type1_error_", mode_i, ".png"),
      width = 16,
      height = 11,
      dpi = DPI
    )
  }

  ## ---------------- average power heatmap ----------------
  power_avg_i <- subset(power_avg_tab, signal_mode == mode_i)
  if (nrow(power_avg_i) > 0) {
    ord_methods <- aggregate(reject_rate ~ method, data = power_avg_i, FUN = mean)
    ord_methods <- ord_methods[order(-ord_methods$reject_rate, ord_methods$method), "method"]
    power_avg_i$method <- factor(power_avg_i$method, levels = rev(ord_methods))

    p_heat <- ggplot(
      power_avg_i,
      aes(x = factor(beta), y = method, fill = reject_rate)
    ) +
      geom_tile() +
      geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", reject_rate)), size = 4) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Average power heatmap -", mode_i, "signal"),
        subtitle = "Averaged over K; numbers inside tiles are empirical power",
        x = "Effect size (beta)",
        y = "Method",
        fill = "Power"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
      )

    save_png(
      p_heat,
      paste0("power_heatmap_avg_", mode_i, ".png"),
      width = 12,
      height = 8.5,
      dpi = DPI
    )
  }

  ## ---------------- null p-value histogram ----------------
  null_i <- subset(long_dat, signal_mode == mode_i & (beta == 0 | is_null == 1))
  if (nrow(null_i) > 0) {
    p_null <- ggplot(
      null_i,
      aes(x = p_value)
    ) +
      geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, closed = "left") +
      facet_grid(method ~ k) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Null p-value distribution -", mode_i, "signal"),
        subtitle = "Uniform-looking histograms indicate reasonable calibration",
        x = "p-value",
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11)
      )

    save_png(
      p_null,
      paste0("null_pvalue_hist_", mode_i, ".png"),
      width = 18,
      height = 18,
      dpi = DPI
    )
  }

  ## ---------------- cluster-order heatmap by beta ----------------
  cluster_i <- subset(cluster_power_tab, signal_mode == mode_i)
  if (nrow(cluster_i) > 0) {
    betas_i <- sort(unique(cluster_i$beta))
    betas_i <- betas_i[betas_i > 0]

    for (b in betas_i) {
      cluster_ib <- subset(cluster_i, beta == b)

      ord_methods <- aggregate(reject_rate ~ method, data = cluster_ib, FUN = mean)
      ord_methods <- ord_methods[order(-ord_methods$reject_rate, ord_methods$method), "method"]
      cluster_ib$method <- factor(cluster_ib$method, levels = rev(ord_methods))

      p_cluster <- ggplot(
        cluster_ib,
        aes(x = factor(cluster_ordered), y = method, fill = reject_rate)
      ) +
        geom_tile() +
        facet_wrap(~ k, ncol = 3) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Power by ordered signal cluster -", mode_i, "signal"),
          subtitle = paste("beta =", b, "| clusters ordered by template abundance"),
          x = "Ordered signal cluster",
          y = "Method",
          fill = "Power"
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
        theme(
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
        )

      save_png(
        p_cluster,
        paste0("cluster_power_", mode_i, "_beta_", clean_filename_num(b), ".png"),
        width = 16,
        height = 11,
        dpi = DPI
      )
    }
  }
}

cat("\nAll figures were saved under:\n", FIG_DIR, "\n", sep = "")
```
